routing.notes: Typed at a WCB console or sent to its serial/ESP-NOW input (? = function character, ; = command character). Checked against WCB 6.2.1 source; commands without "(WCB 6.2+)" also exist in 6.1.5. Board numbers are 1-20 (MAX_WCB_COUNT). Firmware differences: ;S<port>,<msg> strips the comma on 6.2.1, while 6.1.x forwarded ",<msg>"; ;C<key> / ;SEQ<key> run on every mesh board that stores the key on 6.2.1 (6.1.x ran them locally), and ,L (6.2+) keeps a run on this board; ;V is volatile (RAM only) on 6.2.1 but persistent on 6.1.5, and ;VP needs 6.2.1 (6.1.5 reads ;VP,x,1 as a variable named P); ?FUNCCHAR,? and ?CMDCHAR,? need 6.2.1 (6.1.x treats a trailing ? as a help request); ?CONTROLLER is ?SPECIAL on 6.1.x. IF gates the next ^-delimited step and cannot ride inside a ;W or ;T payload; set and test a variable in separate sequences. ?MAP,PWM,CLEAR,OUT reboots the board.
